scripts.example:build: npm run build && npm --workspace examples/my-deck run build
scripts.example:dev: npm run build && npm --workspace examples/my-deck run dev
scripts.docs:demo: npm run example:build && rm -rf docs/public/demo && mkdir -p docs/public/demo && cp -r examples/my-deck/dist/. docs/public/demo/ && rm -rf docs/public/demo/png
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:demo && vitepress build docs
scripts.release:check: npm run clean && npm run build && npm test && npm pack --dry-run -w packages/slide-schema -w packages/slide-core -w packages/slide-components-basic -w packages/create-slide
scripts.release:publish: npm run clean && npm run build && npm test && npm publish -w packages/slide-schema -w packages/slide-core -w packages/slide-components-basic -w packages/create-slide
